title: Conversational Recommendation over Live E-Commerce Catalogues with Self-Refreshing Retrieval
title_zh: 基于自刷新检索的实时电商目录对话式推荐
abstract_en: Conversational recommender systems based on large language models (LLMs) are usually evaluated on static, pre-indexed item collections, yet e-commerce catalogues change continuously as products are added or removed, repriced, and restocked. We present a merchant-agnostic, multi-turn conversational shopping assistant that operates over such live catalogues. Its central component is a self-refreshing retriever that ingests a merchant product feed, enriches the records, and synchronizes them into a vector index. On each run, per-item hashes identify which products are new, changed, deleted, or unchanged, so only the delta is processed rather than rebuilding the whole catalogue. A controller-based dialogue layer consumes this index, using an LLM only for intent classification and preference elicitation while retrieval, reranking, and diversity selection run as dedicated functions. Our demonstration is a WhatsApp shopping assistant in which catalogue changes reach the recommendations after the next successful sync. A live chatbot, documentation, and a recorded walkthrough are available at https://github.com/infobip/infobip-agentic-crs.
abstract_zh: 现有基于大语言模型（LLM）的对话式推荐系统通常在静态、预先建立索引的商品集合上评估，难以适应商品持续上架、下架、调价和补货的实时电商目录。本文提出一种与商家无关、支持多轮对话的购物助手，能够直接运行于动态商品目录之上。其核心是自刷新检索器（self-refreshing retriever）：接收商家商品 Feed，对商品记录进行增强，并同步至向量索引。系统为每件商品计算哈希值，以识别新增、变更、删除和未变化商品，仅处理目录增量，避免全量重建索引。对话层采用控制器架构，仅使用 LLM 进行意图分类和偏好 elicitation，检索、重排序与多样性选择则由专用函数完成。作者实现了一个基于 WhatsApp 的购物助手，目录变更可在下一次成功同步后反映到推荐结果中，并提供了在线聊天机器人、文档和演示视频。
key_points_zh: 提出面向动态电商目录的 merchant-agnostic 多轮对话式购物助手。
通过 per-item hash 检测新增、修改、删除和未变化商品，仅同步目录增量。
自刷新检索器将商品 Feed 增强后同步到向量索引，避免全量重建。
采用 controller-based dialogue，将 LLM 限定用于意图分类和偏好 elicitation。
检索、重排序和多样性选择由专用函数执行，并在 WhatsApp 场景中完成演示。

llm_assessment.comment: A strongly commerce-grounded conversational shopping system that addresses the practical challenge of keeping retrieval and recommendations synchronized with continuously changing product catalogues.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该工作高度聚焦电商购物助手，解决了检索与推荐如何持续同步动态商品目录这一重要实际问题。
